title: Proposal: let Support refund up to $1,000 on any account (DRAFT)
content:
Support refund authority proposal — DRAFT for discussion, NOT approved

Idea: let Support refund up to $1,000 on any account, including contract accounts, without a Billing Ops handoff.

Why: duplicate-charge handoffs for enterprise accounts add days and the CSMs keep hearing about it.

Open questions:
- does Finance accept Support touching contract accounts at all?
- does this collide with the contract adjustments clause?
- where does the $1,000 number come from? gut feel, needs data

Next step: park until someone picks it up. Would need a charter revision to mean anything.
